answer: A shinty club membership with league fixture logs works as the gate: fixtures logged with one club across seasons. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The nectar signal separates the two cases at a glance: Each of 260 aliases needs its own fixture logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The cedar ledger records each payment, the tundra window resets the board, and 260 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
